_metadata.description: Post-viability role alignment, migration, policy, SDK, and expansion work.

requirements.title: Embedding governance reports dimension and retarget risks
requirements.description: AI Gateway should help scenarios avoid irreversible vector-store coupling by checking role metadata, dimensions, content hashes, and migration readiness.

validation.notes: Validates vector-store and embedding metadata advisory findings; full retarget workflow remains in progress.

requirements.title: Role alignment surfaces Ollama/OpenRouter policy gaps
requirements.description: AI Gateway should report missing or mismatched provider roles, including the planned Ollama `extract.structured` role and investigated OpenRouter `embedding.default` role.

validation.notes: Use the role alignment reference before modifying resource policies.

requirements.title: Migration reports guide scenarios away from direct provider coupling
requirements.description: The gateway should produce adoption reports that identify current AI integration patterns, recommended gateway profile replacements, and remaining investigation items.

validation.notes: Validates scanner output can distinguish adopted scenarios from migration candidates; richer adoption report formatting remains planned.

requirements.title: Routing policies enforce privacy, locality, cost, and quality constraints
requirements.description: Profiles such as local-only, local-first, remote-only, quality-first, cheap-first, and privacy-sensitive should be explicit policy objects with deterministic route outcomes.

validation.notes: Validates local-first profile semantics and fallback behavior.
Validates privacy-sensitive routing blocks remote fallback for secret requests.

requirements.title: Typed caller helpers preserve the provider-neutral contract
requirements.description: Caller helpers should reduce boilerplate for scenario authors without exposing provider-specific model fields or bypassing the gateway API.

validation.notes: Validates generated Connect callers can send provider-neutral gateway requests; dedicated SDK helpers remain future work.

requirements.title: Adaptive routing uses operational feedback without hiding policy reasons
requirements.description: Future routing intelligence should learn from quality, latency, cost, failure, and operator feedback while keeping route previews explainable and overrideable. Adaptive scoring is blocked until descriptor-backed route measures (AIGW-ROUTE-MEASURES) are validated; scoring must never hide the hard policy reasons that already govern deterministic routing.

validation.notes: Not implemented. Define adaptive routing acceptance criteria only after AIGW-ROUTE-MEASURES is green and route evidence carries trustworthy analytics fields; conservative deterministic routing remains the shipped behavior.

requirements.title: Fleet enforcement can fail nonconformant AI usage at high maturity
requirements.description: Higher-maturity suites should be able to fail scenarios that bypass AI Gateway when a gateway contract exists and no approved exception is recorded.

validation.notes: Not implemented. Enforcement remains advisory; define rollout after advisory scans and pilot migrations prove the finding taxonomy.

requirements.title: Local route eligibility consults the platform capacity broker
requirements.description: Before selecting a local AI route, the gateway must ask the platform capacity broker (via the `vrooli capacity` CLI/broker contract, never direct GPU/RAM probing) whether the operation-scoped local candidate fits, and record a structured verdict (fit, insufficient_capacity, unknown_capacity, reclaim_required, advisory_reclaim_unavailable). local-only fails closed on insufficient local capacity; local-first may fall back to remote when privacy/cost policy allows; privacy-sensitive/secret never routes remote solely because local capacity is constrained. Any acquired claim is released after execution or bounded by broker TTL on crash.

validation.notes: Fake capacity adapter proves fit selection + claim release, insufficient local-first remote fallback, local-only and privacy-sensitive fail-closed, advisory-reclaim-unavailable treated as unavailable, broker-error degrade-to-unknown, and no-footprint no-op.

requirements.title: Additional providers can join the same role/profile contract
requirements.description: New text or embedding providers should be added behind resource-owned policies and the existing AI Gateway profile contract after Ollama and OpenRouter are stable.

validation.notes: Require a provider integration design before adding any third provider.

requirements.title: Gateway coordinates with image/audio tools without absorbing their provider logic
requirements.description: Cross-modal workflows should coordinate with image-tools and audio-tools while leaving image and audio provider orchestration in those specialized scenarios.

validation.notes: Define coordination contract only after text/embedding gateway routes are implemented.
